rationale: Do not map unpaid or written-off principal to demand drag. It is a lender/borrower balance-sheet transfer unless a deadweight parameter is explicitly applied.
Payment changes affect demand through the actual-payments cashflow layer. Distress deadweight must exclude the scheduled payment cashflow effect already handled elsewhere.
Deadweight conversion applies to delta new defaults relative to baseline, by cell/family/month. Baseline defaults are not a rate-wall drag.
Recoveries and LGD allocation affect balance-sheet incidence; demand drag only equals deadweight share net of recoveries and transfers.
Line cuts, loan denial, bank-capital feedback, and spreads are separate credit-supply margins, not part of this deadweight conversion.
Existing fixed-rate mortgage balances get payment_shock_ratio=0 until reset/refi/move/new-origination exposure is flagged.
Foreclosure legal/admin/forced-move costs may count as deadweight; HPI wealth/collateral revaluation is outside this pack.
Count legal/admin/workout and relationship-capital destruction once. Do not also count investment reductions already produced by cashflow or credit-supply layers.
CRE refi-wall parameters apply only to flagged maturing balloon/refi-exposed loans, never to all CRE stock.
Emit deadweight as a cell/month effect row after P/X/N netting and after cashflow-layer actual-payments-only discipline.
